name: Anatomy Learning Labs: Muscular Lab
summary:
Step into the Muscular Lab of the Anatomy Learning Labs series, where the power and movement of the human body come to life in stunning 3D. Featuring anatomically accurate models developed by medical professionals and learning activities designed by professors, the Muscular Lab teaches elementary, middle, and high school learners how muscles generate movement, maintain posture, and work together with the skeletal system to support everyday activities.
